content.name: Julia Nowak
content.title: Customer Service Representative (German, English, Polish)
content.summary: Trilingual customer service representative (German, English, Polish) with a business degree from HWR Berlin and two and a half years in e-commerce and mobility support. Handles around 70 tickets a day and keeps a satisfaction score above 4.5 out of 5.

experience.title: Werkstudentin Customer Support (student job)
bullets: Answered email and chat questions about orders, returns and deliveries for a subscription food box, about 20 hours a week during my studies.
Handled Polish-language tickets for the new Polish market launch, covering roughly 150 tickets a week on my own.
Suggested new canned responses for the five most common return questions, which the team adopted in Freshdesk.

experience.title: Customer Service Representative
bullets: Support riders of an e-scooter and e-bike sharing app by chat, email and phone in German, English and Polish, around 70 contacts a day.
Process refunds and fine disputes following clear rules, keeping incorrect refunds below 1% in monthly audits.
Report recurring app bugs to the product team with screenshots and steps, and three of my reports led to fixes in the next release.
Keep an average customer satisfaction score of 4.6 out of 5 across more than 9,000 rated conversations.

education.school: Hochschule für Wirtschaft und Recht Berlin
education.details: Final grade 1.9; thesis on chatbot handover in customer service

achievements.title: Market launch support
achievements.detail: Covered Polish-language support alone during Kiezkorb's first three months in Poland.

achievements.title: University mentoring
achievements.detail: Mentored first-year students in HWR Berlin's buddy programme for two semesters.
